- [IRET.1.12] **Mockable clock source.** Two clock function
  pointers per engine, sharing one context, supply the
  monotonic and the wall sample ([IRET.14]); no subsystem
  reads a platform clock directly. Live mode uses `CLOCK_MONOTONIC` and
  `CLOCK_REALTIME`; test / replay mode uses harness-controlled
  counters.
